entities.summary: Artistic and philosophical principles emphasizing harmony, proportion, idealized beauty, and the imitation of nature. From Greek theories of kalos kagathos to Renaissance perspective and humanism, these aesthetic principles shaped Western art, architecture, and literature for two millennia.
